done.why: I stopped after a short sample of the opening area. I had not found anything that pulled me further in.

about: A cave adventure. You start at the foot of an endless stair after a dream about a silver-haired man who says you face a final test. You carry a brass lantern, and the passages beyond are dark, with a grue and a sword in a rock.

moments.note: The game calls the lantern a lamp and refuses to let me eat it.
Pulling the sword from the rock got 'Who do you think you are? Arthur?'
Climbing the stair got 'The stairs are endless' even when I said up.

wished: Smell the mist and have the game respond to it.
Go up the stair and find out why it is endless.

lines.line: Who do you think you are? Arthur?
lines.why: A joke that answered my odd attempt.

fun.why: A few light touches, but I only played briefly.

engagement.why: I left early, so little pulled me in.

difficulty.why: I didn't hit any real obstacle in this short stretch.

interestingness.why: The setup is a familiar dream-and-test framing, with a sword in a rock and a grue.

prose.why: The room descriptions are clear and atmospheric.
